g.text: MarieRank1Convo3 begins.

Il y a un crâne volant ! Keksekça ?! There is a flying talking skull and everyone is going on about their days as if nothing is happening and I need someone to acknowledge the strangeness of their whole existence.
That's just Necraloid. Well, a necraloid. It's complicated.
That is Necraloid. He's a Cephalon, he won't hurt you.
[End.]
Pardon, is it a name or an object ?
I do not think him a threat ! He does not frighten me.
Chat ends.
I... don't rightly know.
Yes.

Indeed, I find him perfectly charming, if a bit unyielding in conversation. Not wholly unlike his living inspiration. But given the nature of my favored traveling companion, you can tell that does not bother me overmuch.
Firstly, of whose designs are these, "Necraloids ?" Of which they are a name and also, perhaps, a designation ?
I... do not understand. And how does Loid factor into this ?
No, what you might find grotesque in his visage, I assure you, is not the issue I currently have at hand.
Your Cardinal Dimanche. Entrati.
Entrati made that one. But the concept of what they are - Cephalons - was invented by the Orokin.
I'm surprised the skull isn't off-putting for you.
I admit, taken out of context, he must be strange. But what in particular is upsetting?
Excusez-moi, do you mean to imply that le Cardinal made a replicant flying skull servant in the likeness of his own companion, and named them thusly ?
You know little of me, which is no fault of yours. I have spent much of my life tending to the dead and the places that they repose.
I find myself curious as to why there is another face upon his back that resembles a child's scrawl.
Why are there not more of them, these necraloids, then ?
Indeed I have spent much of my life with them as my boon companions. They are keen to listen to my troubles of the day.
I inquired with Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid both, and neither wished to speak of it, they only told me a name. Otak. And it was with great sadness that they uttered it.
Maybe he realized how horrifying it is to make yourself a digital copy of your lover.
Maybe he only ever intended to make the one.
I'm not sure. Maybe he never got around to making more?
Update boolean MarieGraveyard1
So here I am, speaking with you, in hopes you might be able to aid me.
Ou bien, a tribute to his love and respect, that he did not think this strange laboratory could continue to function without Monsieur Loid.
+5 Chemistry
Imagine it, a school of flying skulls, all effortlessly and perfectly efficient !
Did you like looking after graveyards?
Did they ever respond?
Do you want to know about Otak? Or why you can't talk to him?
Otak is hard to explain...
I would say that it makes for a strange kind of romantic gesture, but I'm hardly one to talk.
I wouldn't mind a necraloid buzzing around my place, honestly.
Tragic and beautiful, in its way, non ? A tribute to his love and respect, that he did not think this strange laboratory could continue to function without Monsieur Loid.
I'm glad there's only one of him, honestly. I don't think the world would be ready for that.
And mausoleums and cryptes, oh yes. But I do admit I preferred the outdoor spaces, though they were challenging for my chair to navigate. No more so than stairs, I fear.
Hah ! No, thankfully. Not until your "Necraloid" with such a morbid visage replied to me. If speaking to the dead is within the gifts of the Luminaries to bestow, it is not within my knowing.
I believe I wish to know both, in time, but I will let you decide where to begin. I do not know which is more important, après tout.
Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete
And now I am intrigued, but that seems a story for another time. Cela dit...
Then I have all certainty that you are likely beset by either a need for company or organization, or both. But that is a conversation for another time.
I think it had more to do with ensuring this place didn't fall apart at the seams, than anything else.
Indeed ! As am I. Which brings me to my next question.
Update boolean MarieSerum1

No, hearing spirits and voices is much more within the purview of my dear Lyon than I. Though I wonder if Monsieur Necraloid is not haunted as well, judging by the child's scrawl upon the back of his head.
Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.
true
false
Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.
false
And you very well may be right. The flying amalgam seems to be missing much of the real Monsieur Loid's raison d'être and nuance. Cela dit...
I didn't know if it was appropriate to ask about whether or not your feet were changed by the serum...
Your chair?
That is actually why I came here to speak to you, if you do not mind.
Update boolean MarieOtak1
Update boolean MarieFamily1
+10 Chemistry
I do not know what you would name it ? Un fauteuil roulant, or... perhaps a term I deeply dislike, un fauteuil pour invalide.
Par les Luminaires... please, go on.
Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!
Oh ! Oh, you poor thing. Imagine you, sitting there, wondering if I had mes pieds taken from me by le Cardinal ! Non, non, non - nothing of the sort.
Like what we perch in now, to sit at these little adorable devices to communicate. But with wheels upon the sides, to traverse. A chair with wheels, if you will.
By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.
His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.
Sol saw fit to place in my life the inconvenience of having been born with traditionally unwieldy feet. I could not walk.
You were an invalid before you became a protoframe?
We call them wheelchairs, believe it or not.
Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful warframes and weapons we make.
Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.
But it was simply that, an inconvenience.
Non. I very much was not.
Hah ! Oh, how I am sitting here laughing at myself for being the fool. Yes, I suppose you would call them wheelchairs, as they are chairs with wheels. Silly me.
He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank
Though, I do not miss having to push myself about. Nor does Lyon, I imagine. What freedom it is to fly !
Update boolean MarieInvalid
For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.
She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.
true
She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.
false
I try to think of disabilities as things that change us. They limit us in some ways, yes, but they can give us strengths that others don't have.
You never thought of your condition as a problem?
Did you know the protoframe serum would do this to you?
Chat ends.
Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.
Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
+5 Chemistry
I never saw the point in bemoaning it. I certainly relish the ability to fetch objects from high shelves without aid, I will tell you that.
Oui, le Cardinal told Lyon and I all that would come of taking the sérums that changed our forms. We knew what it would do.
+5 Chemistry
I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.
It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.
Update boolean MarieSecretPower
Ce qui est fait est fait. I could not pray to Sol for a miracle, when so many were hurting more around me, when so many were of greater need. The Luminaries had already given me so much.
But like all things, I took mine in joy, and Lyon took his... oh, I fear as if I am telling on him and I should not.
Pauvre petit...
While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...
+10 Chemistry
Oui ! You understand. I knew the world from another point of view. My arms were stronger. I am more patient. I know what it means to enjoy the moment.
I must go. Thank you for this wonderful diversion.
It's all right. Don't tell me anything more than you're comfortable with.
Please, keep going. I'm having a hard time getting through to him.
So, he was transferred to the main necraloid - the only Necraloid that remains - and is... well? It's hard to explain.
I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?
Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.
When I reach my destination, I bask in the elegance of it. I do not scurry about like a beetle with a billion little legs.
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
I just wish we could fix him, honestly. Bring back the real Otak.
He makes me smile. He's funny, but it hides something tragic and broken.
Sadly, he's not fixable. And I think he grates on a lot of nerves.
You're right. I wish there was something we could do.
It's not really my decision to make.
I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.
I simply wish my dear Lyon could see the world in such a way as you. That all inconveniences may be a secret power, as you say.
I appreciate your kindness, Drifter. I will simply leave it at this, as to not overstep any imposition I may be placing upon you -
You are not alone in that, Drifter. Lyon is like family to me, and still sometimes I wonder if I know him any more than the statues of saints in the cathedral.
+15 Chemistry
+15 Chemistry
+15 Chemistry
Add 1 to Family
I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.
+10 Chemistry
I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.
I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
Oh, I fear as if I am telling on him and I should not.
- Lyon paints the world in a crimson brush, whatever his outward demeanor may seem to belie. I am sorry he still does not speak to you. I am urging him to do so...
Check boolean MarieLyonSuffering1
I know the compulsion you feel. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.
I know how you feel. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.
Yes, I... know of a similar situation. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.
+15 Chemistry
I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.
And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
Add 1 to Family
+5 Chemistry
Update boolean MarieLyonSuffering1
You have been clever already to sniff out that Lyon holds a deep and painful burden in his heart. One that he feels he alone must carry.
true
Lyon holds a deep and painful burden in his heart. One that he feels he alone must carry.
false
À la revoyure.
Perhaps there is ! I would not give up hope. We must understand the root illness, if we are to treat it, non ?
That we hide some great and terrible sin.
+5 Chemistry
And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
I must go. Thank you for this wonderful diversion.
Update boolean MarieLyonSuffering2
Update boolean MarieLyonSuffering1
Chat ends.
And it is that sin that must be forgiven.
Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.
Chat ends.
I am sorry he still does not speak to you. I am urging him to do so...
Thank you, you have given me much to think on. À la revoyure.
I worry his compulsion to paint all the world with a crimson brush will be his undoing.
Chat ends.
I must go. Merci pour cette merveilleuse distraction.
Chat ends.
